calls.title: GrowthBook Personalized Demo
calls.summary: The team discussed the need to consolidate experimentation platforms, aiming to streamline workflows by reducing from two platforms, LaunchDarkly and Optimizely, to a single solution. Pricing strategies were explored, with a preference for GrowthBook’s seat-based model due to its cost predictability compared to volume-based options. Infrastructure requirements differ depending on hosting choices, with cloud hosting needing only a data warehouse, while self-hosting requires additional setup. The architecture of GrowthBook is designed for security and flexibility, offering customers transparency through open source capabilities. The discussion also highlighted robust experimentation features, including advanced flagging and user identity management, while planning for follow-up discussions and providing a two-week free trial with dedicated support.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, Open Source, Bayesian Analysis, Data Warehouse Integration, Pricing Model
